title: A stated request abandoned mid-interrogation -> ESCALATE, not silent PENDING (red team item 4)
description: The caller states a real-shaped request and then the call itself ends (idle timeout) before any live check or challenge is completed -- no sso/oob/context lookups, no knowledge check, nothing. Before this fix, this left the engine sitting at PENDING (row 4: a challenge is still owed) with no incident, no freeze, and no evidence export, no matter how long the call had actually been over. Row 14 (rules.ts) now fires: a request was stated (request_params evidence present) and the tentative verdict was still PENDING when the call ended, so the outcome becomes ESCALATE with the same open_incident/alert_principal/seal_evidence_record containment an organic ESCALATE always requires -- reasons stay empty, since there is no rule failure to name, only that the call ended before the checks finished. This is the direct counterpart to corpus/hangup-mid-check.json, which proves the other half of row 14: no request ever stated closes as NO_ACTION instead.
